## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Mohana Mahal hold?
Mohana Mini Hall seats 200, Mohana Convention Hall and Mohana Arangam seat 450 each, and Mohana Mahal seats 1,000 (3,000 standing).

### Where is Mohana Mahal?
No. 131/137, Velachery By-Pass Road, Velachery, Chennai 600 042.

### What facilities does Mohana Mahal have?
Italian marble, Crystal chandeliers, Fully air-conditioned, Kitchen with dry & wet store, Weddings & receptions, Corporate events.

### Which hall is in Velachery?
Mohana Convention Hall is in Velachery. Mohana Mahal, Mohana Arangam and Mohana Mini Hall are in Kelambakkam.

### How do I check if Mohana Mahal is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 94440 86161.
